messages:
From: Sara Niemi <sara@nordicmetrics.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 13:12:00 +0100
Subject: Request: localized case study and testimonial (FI/SE)

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Were excited about publishing the joint case study and would like to localize it for our Nordic markets. Two quick asks:

1) Can Redwood sign off on publishable Finnish and Swedish versions of the case study and the testimonial quote from our Head of ML? Wed like to publish both translated PDFs on our site and use the quotes in regional marketing.
2) Any Redwood legal / brand requirements we should follow for translated wording, logo use, or retention of the original English QA version?

Ive attached the English PDF wed like to localize (NordicMetrics_case-study_EN.pdf) and a short list of proposed in-market reviewers (Pekka Virtanen, Henrik Andersson). If theres a checklist you prefer we follow for translations and signoffs, please share. Our ideal publish window is the week of Nov 23.

Thanks — happy to set a quick 15-min sync if faster.

Best,
Sara
Sr. Product Marketing Manager
NordicMetrics Oy

Attachment: NordicMetrics_case-study_EN.pdf (application/pdf)

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: Sara Niemi <sara@nordicmetrics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: localized case study and testimonial (FI/SE)

Sara —

Appreciate the context and the proposed reviewers. Quick responses inline: 

- We are happy to support localized Finnish and Swedish versions. Redwood requires:
  * a final translated quote that your legal and the in-market reviewer approve;
  * a short redline window for Redwood legal to confirm theres no changed meaning for claims (e.g., cost/latency numbers);
  * signed logo release for use in marketing in-country.

- Im attaching a brief "localization_checklist.xlsx" that lays out our preferred signoff flow (translator -> in-market reviewer -> legal -> brand). Can you confirm Pekka and Henrik are the primary reviewers? If you prefer, we can arrange a native-language reviewer on our side.

Proposed timeline: translations returned by Nov 18, Redwood legal review Nov 19-20, publish week of Nov 23 (your target). Does that work?

Also: for APAC (we noticed Kokoro Tech wants a Japanese version), can you confirm whether the Japanese testimonial text will be identical to the English quote or will they want a localized adaptation? If its an adaptation well follow the same signoff flow and ask for a DocuSign logo release for JP.

Link to our internal localization workflow (read-only): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-localization-workflow

Next steps: 
- Please upload translations to the folder or send as a zip.
- Confirm in-market reviewers and a preferred deadline (Nov 18 ideally).

Thanks — Ill loop in Marcus to confirm JP process.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: localization_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks Ben —

Confirmed: Pekka Virtanen (pekka.virtanen@nordicmetrics.fi) and Henrik Andersson (henrik@normetrics.se) are the reviewers. Ive attached a small zip with draft translations (NordicMetrics_translations_draft.zip) — Finnish and Swedish drafts include the testimonial quote and a suggested localized headline.

About APAC: Kokoro Tech (contact: Taro Saito) wants a Japanese landing page and may request a slightly different phrasing to align with local marketing. Theyre fine with the same approval flow, and we can route JP quote through your legal as well.

Deadline: well aim to have in-market reviewers back by end of day Nov 18. If legal needs more time, please tell us what you need.

Best,
Sara

From: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, Sara Niemi <sara@nordicmetrics.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: localized case study and testimonial (FI/SE)

Ben / Laura / Sara —

Forwarding final notes from Legal/Brand on production-ready steps. Short version: we can proceed on the proposed timeline, with these requirements: 

1) Translations must be provided as editable source (DOCX) plus localized PDF for publication. We prefer a single folder with language subfolders.
2) Any numerical claims (e.g., "40% cost reduction") must include a one-line provenance statement in the localized document. If the Finnish/Swedish wording implies a materially different metric, Legal will request edits.
3) Logo use: we need a signed logo release for each legal entity and each region. Im attaching redwood_brand_logo_release_v2.pdf as the DocuSign-ready form. Please have your procurement/marketing sign and return.
4) Testimonial adaptations: allowed but must be flagged and approved by Redwood Legal. Small tonal edits (shortening, flow) are OK; substantive changes are not.

Next steps for Sara / NordicMetrics: upload the DOCX source for each language to the shared Drive folder and have Pekka / Henrik sign off in a short email thread so we have an audit trail. Then sign the logo release via DocuSign and return. Ill run legal review on Nov 19-20.

Targets: translations in by Nov 18 -> legal review Nov 19-20 -> DocuSign signed by Nov 22 -> publish week of Nov 23.

If anything slips, we can roll the publish to the following week but want the audit trail in place.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_brand_logo_release_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
